sense.text:
Starting January they’re going to fine you $500 for texts they call hate speech, and if you text about the Arabs or about the so-called Jewish people, that’s really what it’s talking about. This is the new world, welcome to 2024. Guess what: the Bible uses many words, and we’re going to use these words.

“How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!” There are many things Esau has kept secret, things he has hidden in this earth, in this world, but it’s going to be sought up; it shall be searched out. That’s why a lot of information is coming out now.

And it’s coming out of their own mouths. Their own old dictionaries, the ones brothers search out and find, say ‘a tradition prevails that a small number of the Amalekites colonized a part of Greece’, and that the Macedonians and Spartans sprung from that stock: Alexander the Greek and them stem from the Amalekites. Their own scholars write that the modern Jews are descendants of Russian steppe tribesmen who converted to Judaism in mass around 740 AD, the Khazars, ‘of highly aggressive caucasoid genetic stock’: highly aggressive means warlike, they like violence. The Ashkenazi Jews, the prime victims of Hitler’s Holocaust, ‘have no historical or genetic connection with the biblical Jews of Palestine at all’, and that was known among the smartest of them and among the non-Jewish historians from at least 1700 AD, ‘a well-known if disguised and ignored fact’. The Hasidic side locks, those little damn curls, that stupid yarmulke on their head, the rabbi’s fur trimmed hat like a gallon of milk up there, gefilte fish: none of that is Jewish. Brothers, when y’all are on the street, challenge these people: where do you read about the yarmulke, the fur hat, the curly cues in the Bible? It ain’t in there. It’s not for you to prove that you’re the Jews; they have to prove it their damn selves, and they can’t.

Another of their scholars, in Who Is Esau Edom, writes that the bulk of the Ashkenazi Jews came from the Khazars, that ‘the Kazar are also of Edomite stock and both stocks make up the present day Jews’, and that the original stock of the Khazars came from the land of Edom. That’s their scholars; that’s not something we sat down and wrote. They write that the term anti-Semitism has been used ‘to counter and conceal God’s natural order and plan in the world’: anytime you read the true Hebrew scriptures they call you an anti-Semite, because they don’t want the truth to come out. That order assigns to them the role of aggressor, hater, destroyer, seducer, invader and corruptor, and they are all of those. That’s what their scholars put together.

A book from 1830, Modern Judaism, says ‘the descendants of Esau’ are ‘the sworn enemies of the descendants of Jacob even to the end of the world’. That’s for those of you that say, oh, I got a good white friend named Timmy, I got a white friend named Carrie: it says sworn enemies. As long as our empire thrived and flourished they stayed small in their area at Mount Seir; after the twelve tribes were destroyed by the Assyrians and Babylonians they ‘wonderfully increased in numbers and strength’, extended their dominion toward the west, took over Italy, founded Rome, and they had the Roman Empire. They overturned the Jewish state that was restored when we came back from Persia, the second temple was destroyed by Titus, and then Rome accepted Christianity, what they call Roman Catholicism, that twisted perversion of scripture. ‘They hold the dominion over all Europe’: that means the Germans, the French, the English, the Swedish, the Russians, the Ukrainians, the Belgians, the Italians, and guess what, the Americans, all fall under that.

‘Esau detaining in captivity his brother Jacob’: we know a little bit of history. We know we are in captivity, along with the indigenous Indians, so that means we all are Jacob. One and one is two. And it says that until ‘Messiah Ben David shall appear’, the anointed son of David, who is Christ.

Their scholars also write that the prophecies of Isaiah, Jeremiah and Obadiah against Esau, Edom and Seir ‘have not yet received their full accomplishment’. So what in the hell are those apologetics talking about? You damn liars. The house of Esau has had some particular judgments, some judgments like World War One and World War Two, but the final vengeance for the destruction of the second temple and the transportation of the Jews into captivity, ‘in which they are still most appropriately detained’, is still to come in the time of the Messiah. That’s why we tell you brothers, wait on Messiah. Are the people over there in Israel who call themselves Jewish detained? No. That’s talking about us over here, in Haiti, Jamaica. And it says those plagues against Edom and Mount Seir all belong to Rome and the Christians, and the Christians will get a worse judgment than the Muslims. Esau is a violent, violent man; we’ve been telling y’all that for a long time.

precepts.why:
“Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.” Christ is talking about the Pharisees: don’t fear man. Why? Because there’s nothing they’ve covered up that shall not be revealed, and nothing they’ve hidden that shall not be known.

That is how the hidden things of Esau are sought up. Everybody understand that: that’s why a lot of information is coming out now.

“So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.” God makes their own tongue fall on them: their own people are the ones coming up, getting pissed off at their ancestors and their own people, saying they did this, they did that.

An Edomite man, a CIA agent, confessed on his deathbed that he murdered Bob Marley. He gave Bob Marley a new pair of sneakers, and you know Negroes love sneakers, and it had a needle in it. Bob Marley put the sneaker on, got pricked, and that’s what killed him, slowly but surely. Just like the white woman, Carolyn Bryant, the woman that had Emmett Till put to death: she confessed it was her, she lied, she admitted to her lie. What are y’all finding out? They are the devil the Bible speaks of.

Their own scholars and their own books confess it too, that the modern Jews are converts with no connection to the people of the Bible. Even the president of Syria broke code. He said the Jews who came to Palestine are Khazar Jews, pagans who converted, with nothing to do with the ancient people of Israel. So people thinking we’re making some racist statement: no, even the president of Syria acknowledges that thing. And he asked why we hear about six million and not about the 26 million Soviets killed in that war. I bet nobody in here would know how many died; all we ever hear about is six million. In Nigeria I asked a brother what’s worse, 100 million Negroes taken from Nigeria to the Americas dying in the Middle Passage, or six million, and he said six million was worse. You can’t make up the amount of brainwashing that affects black people through Christianity. The methods were not specific to those Khazarian Jews: black people were killed in those things, we were in the military, Puerto Ricans were there too, Native Americans, look it up, we were killed just like these Khazarian Ashkenazi people, but our deaths don’t matter.

So the Lord is making their own tongue fall upon themselves. That devil broke code.

The Arab man said the land is not Palestine, it’s called Philistine; I’ve been telling y’all it’s the same word. And he admitted Hebrew was extinct as a spoken language, and everything about Israel was manufactured, engineered; in other words, fake. Everything about them is fake, but people believe they’re the people of the book and that’s the holy language. How wrong you all are.

Their scholars wrote, ‘If Esau’s true identity and traits become publicly known’; hold that. The Bible says “And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”. The spirit of the Lord’s mouth is the Bible, and the Bible does not speak by itself, brothers: it needs a man to go out and teach it.

So after the point of him being revealed, Christ said, I’m going to come back and destroy. The book goes on, ‘he will once again be powerless in the world’: he’s going to get jacked up by the Lord. And ‘the Jews have inherited these attributes of Esau and frantically try to silence anyone who would reveal them.’ That’s why this is a war. When we tell y’all this is war, we mean it’s war: the Lord said he would have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

The anti-Semitic charge goes along with the hate laws, the same thing we were just reading about with the fines for hate speech. It’s a tool used in defense of their offensive, hostile, revolutionary and antichrist nature: they’re Antichrist. Charge a man with anti-Semitism and the masses can be turned against him, forcing him into silence or loss of status in society, business or politics. That’s what’s going to happen. This is why Hitler was blasting their behinds: they were taking over everything, just like they’re doing now. They got the banks, the communications, the government, the media, the IMF, the World Bank; they got it all. But there is a God, brothers and sisters, there is a God.

sense.text: “Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man.” Ask our sisters and brothers who the evil man is, and some of them, especially if they’re Christian, will point to a brother or sister in the gang, the Bloods or the Crips. That’s not the evil man the Bible is talking about. When it talks about man it’s talking about a type of man: the Edomite man, the white man, the Caucasian man.

“Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.” Black, we don’t war. Our people don’t; the Bloods and Crips don’t understand war. Sure, they might rob you, but that’s not war. The white man understands war. Do they have tanks? Do they got nuclear devices? Do they have missiles? We ain’t got none of that.

So you looking at the Negro, your fellow black brothers and sisters on the street, talking about those are the violent? No. Tyrone can’t make war. Soon as Tyrone see a cop, guess what Tyrone do: he run down his block. That’s not war.

“They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent”: meaning their philosophies, their doctrines, their speech is like serpent poison. It’s poisonous; it’ll kill you. “Adders’ poison is under their lips”: whatever they say, brothers, it’s poison, whether it’s religious speech or political speech.

“Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked”: they calling them the wicked here too. “Preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.”

Then the class looked at the violent man in Gaza. First their old folks, the ones that call themselves Jewish people, and then the young ones. I know what you’re thinking: that’s not how the young fake Israelis feel, it’s a new generation, they’re different. No. The young ones are no different. The only time they feel sorry is when you punch them in the mouth. I’m not saying do that; don’t go out and hurt nobody. In Israel, male and female have to join the military, so these women are in the army too.

They like to say don’t call it genocide. What they’re doing is genocide, and it is. They did it to us, and they’re doing it over there to them. And Palestinians, we might feel a little something, but y’all did it to us as well, so you don’t get a pass for what you did to us. That’s how they got the land: Egypt, Tanzania, Morocco, Libya, North Africa. They wiped us out. I’m talking about Arabs. They don’t get a pass.

I’m showing you the violent man: this is the acts of the violent man. The argument is, we’re killing Hamas. Let’s say Hamas has 500 members. You mean all those women you killed, all those children you killed, are Hamas members? You can’t make this stuff up. Stop the lies.

They told the people to go south, it’s going to be safer there; they went south, and that’s where they bombed them. Y’all got to see the trickery of this man. Keep trusting this white man. And the reason we know about it is because it’s televised. We’re just starting to find out the evil the white man here did to us, how they murdered us. If you think this is a war, put a picture of Tel Aviv, with all their big skyscrapers, side by side with a picture of Gaza, and you judge if that is a war.

precepts.why:
Now let’s see what Christ says about that, for you lying Christians out there. “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy.” When you hear the word thief you think of Tyrone and Pooky. Tyrone and Pooky might have robbed you, but they are not the thief. Pooky and Tyrone ain’t destroying nothing. This is talking about a major thief in the earth, a major stealer, a major destroyer: the violent man who purposed to overthrow our goings.

“I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.” Christ said he’s come that they might have life: that the Israelites might have life, and have it more abundantly.

sense.text:
We’re all familiar with this scripture. Your mama probably read it to you as a baby; your pastor probably read it to you in church. “But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.” Read with verse 14: “For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.”

The first Christian thought that hits everybody’s brain is: forgive the white man for all his evil that he done. But you won’t forgive Pooky, right? What the hell is this? You forgive that white man. Christ is talking to the Israelites, about the Israelites, for the Israelites.

The Christian Arabs show you they have an understanding of what the Bible is saying. Over Gaza they said: we will not forgive you, we will not accept your words of apology; the words of shock will come and the charities will come. And on YouTube now they got charities for Gaza; it’s all BS, and he knows it. It’s black Christians who are clueless: oh look, they care for us. No they don’t.

Black Christians have got to be some of the stupidest people on earth. We’re the only race that forgives everything. They spit on our mothers, rape our mothers, kick our daughters and sisters: oh, let’s forgive them. You stupid effeminate Christian men especially.

The brother down in Texas was killed by his neighbor, a woman, while he was eating ice cream on his own damn couch. In the courtroom the family hugged her so ever so gently, caressed her blonde hair, made her feel comfortable, and told her: you killed our son, you killed our brother, and the one thing we want you to remember is we forgive you. The judge, a black sister, got off the judge stool, gave her her personal Bible, kissed her and hugged her. If you think she killed that man by mistake, you stupid as hell. And she got the nerve to appeal her sentence.

Arabs don’t do that. Whites don’t do that. Chinese don’t do that. East Indians don’t do that. Filipinos don’t do that. We’re the only ones that do this: oh, just forgive everybody. This is what religion done to our people. We become dumber and dumber. Lord help us, we become so stupid upon the earth.

Now I know they thinking God don’t feel like that. Here is how God feels about Christians.

“I am sought of them that asked not for me”: our people never asked for the Lord. “I am found of them that sought me not”: we were in slavery. “I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.” Why were we not called by God’s name? We were not called by the name of Israel anymore, because we were called African, African-American, Jamaican, Haitian, Puerto Rican, Brazilian. They changed our identity. That’s what it means.

“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people”: we are that rebellious people, “which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts.” Our people walk after their own thoughts.

“Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me”: because we try to give them the truth, and they say, stand by yourself. Brother, don’t give me no flyer. Sister, I don’t want to hear what you got. “For I am holier than thou”: I’m Holy Ghost filled and water baptized, I am washed in the blood of the Lamb.

“These are a smoke in my nose”: God can’t stand them. Smoke in your nose is when you can’t breathe, you can’t stand it. “A fire that burneth all the day”: that is God’s anger. So my anger is God’s anger, although I can never be as angry as he is. My anger is a little thing.

“Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir.” Mount Seir was the homeland of Edom, in what they call the Middle East today. But guess what: they’re not there today. They have scattered, like we read earlier, into Italy, throughout all the western areas, France, Germany, America. “And prophesy against it”: so God is telling us to prophesy against the white man.
“Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.”

“I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate.” I want y’all to see what God’s prophecy is. Look at the architecture of the old Mount Seir: is that not the same as the capitol in Washington DC? It’s the same architecture. The difference is nobody dwells in the old place today, so God’s not talking about prophesying against a place where nobody lives. He’s saying prophesy against the modern-day Mount Seir.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: the word perpetual means forever. That hatred doesn’t stop; it’s an ongoing hatred. I don’t care if they’re nice to you today. There are those you will work with and come across in life who are somewhat friendly, approachable, kind, nice, for a week, for several months, maybe even a year, but there will come a day when in nature they’ll start to feel a certain way about you. We’ve all seen it on certain jobs: your boss will say, I want you to train Karen or Tommy, and before you know it Karen or Tommy got your job and they are over you.

“And hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword”: so what they’re doing in Gaza is nothing different than what they’ve done to us. “In the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”: our iniquity had an end when we got emancipated. But did the hate stop when we got emancipated? Hell no. They came with the Ku Klux Klan, Jim Crow, sharecropping, agricultural laws, Black Codes, the 13th Amendment, redlining, all kinds of things. They kept giving new names, but it’s the same oppression.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee.” Why? “Sith thou hast not hated blood”: since Esau has not hated blood, “even blood shall pursue thee.” That’s what we read earlier: they are the evil man, they are the violent man, they are the wicked. There are various names God calls them. Judgment’s coming for them.

“Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth. And I will fill his mountains with his slain men.” “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return.”

Why? “Because thou hast said, These two nations”: Judah and Israel. Remember, we were divided into two nations. “And these two countries”: Israel and the other country, now America. Those are the two countries, Israel and America. “Shall be mine, and we will possess it”: we will invade it, we will take it.

“Whereas the Lord was there”: the Lord was with us. They took Israel and called themselves Jewish people. The word Judah means praise of God, so they call themselves the praise of God. They took America as Christians and said they are the anointed. Christian means anointed of God; it doesn’t mean follower of Christ. Some books say that, but when you break down the etymology it means anointed ones. That’s how they stole this land, America. So blood’s going to pursue them.

precepts.why: Some are new online, so: how do you know the white man dwells in Mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” Esau is Edom, and Esau dwelt in Mount Seir. So when God says “set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”, it is Esau, Edom, the white man, that we set our face against.

sense.text:
Brothers, I need y’all to understand the scriptures, because the nations, particularly this white man, have corrupted the truth. “For we are not as many”: meaning the Israelites that are rising up in the faith of Christ, keeping the commandments, are not like the many “which corrupt the word of God.” So many have corrupted the word of God: that’s your church system.

“But as of sincerity”: we teach the Bible in sincerity, brothers and sisters. “But as of God”: we teach as God called us. “In the sight of God”: we teach in the sight of God. “Speak we in Christ”: we speak in the name of Christ.

precepts.why:
“I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel.” Some of you men, some of you women, get shaken when you go through adversity. Just like you get adversity today, back then they got it too, and they left and went back to animal sacrifice. There’s no animal sacrifice today, so the understanding is: many of you leave this truth and go back to Christianity. You go back to being a Negro: I used to be an Israelite, now I am a born again Christian again, now I am a Catholic again, now I am a Protestant.

“Which is not another”: it’s not another, because the same book we use, they use. The difference is they corrupt the scriptures. “But there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.” Do you see what they do? They pervert the gospel of Christ. They say forgive your enemies; forget about slavery, it’s old time, it came around 1619. But don’t forget Thanksgiving, that came around 1619 too: celebrate Thanksgiving, Happy Thanksgiving, just forget about your slavery, forgive us. Go back to that, and now you love everybody, you hug and kiss everybody. You become one of these damnable Christians. That is the many which corrupt the word of God.

sense.text: “Now we have received, not the spirit of the world”: brothers, sisters, we receive not the spirit of the world. The world teaches us to be stupid, and when I say stupid I mean following their philosophies. We’re not to be taken by the spirit of the world. “But the spirit which is of God”: that’s the Holy Spirit, “that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.”

“Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teacheth.” Man’s wisdom teaches you that economics is the way to salvation, that economics is what black people need for salvation. That’s a lie; we’ve heard that crap before. I’m not saying money is not important; the Bible says money answers all things, so I’m not knocking that. But when you put money over Christ there’s a problem.

“But which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.” In our teaching we must compare spiritual things with spiritual, meaning precept upon precept, here a little and there a little, line upon line. That’s what he’s saying.

“But the natural man”: the natural man is the sinful man. He “receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God”: they cannot understand the Bible. “For they are foolishness unto him.” Brother, you mean to tell me that all we got to do is return as Israelites, keep the commandments and believe in Christ our King? That’s it? Yeah, that’s it. Brother, I don’t believe that; I think we need to protest in the streets, organize, put our money together, go against the white man and get our guns. That is the natural man: it’s foolishness unto him. “Neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.” You got to have the spirit of God to be able to understand his Bible.
“But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man”: meaning if you’re keeping the commandments, no man can judge you, meaning condemn you.

precepts.why:
“And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom”: we want the Lord to show us the secrets of wisdom. “That they are double to that which is”: the Bible has dual meanings, double meanings. That’s why it’s a spiritual book, and that’s why it says comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

Brothers and sisters, you can read the Bible like a novel. I implore you, read your four chapters a day; read it like a novel, that’s good. But to understand the spiritual things you need to learn precept upon precept; you need to learn how to compare spiritual things with spiritual.

“Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth”: our iniquity deserves death.

sense.text:
Our iniquity deserves death. Here is a secret the Christians ain’t figured out yet. “And they shall be upon thee”: the they is the curses. “And upon thy seed for ever.” For how long? Forever.

That means the curses of God are in a rotation. It didn’t stop in Assyria, it kept going. It didn’t stop in Babylon, it kept going. It didn’t stop with the Persians and the Medes, the Greeks or the Romans, it kept going. It didn’t stop with Spain or France, it kept going, even here in America. But it ends when Christ returns.

If you talk to Christians, those that think they’re studied or astute, they’ll say, oh no, those curses ended with Rome. They’re stupid; don’t waste your time talking to them.

precepts.why:
Here is the precept of Deuteronomy 28:46. “I will liken my judgment unto a ring”: a ring meaning a circle; it continues. “Like as there is no slackness of the last”: no slackness, meaning the beginning of God’s judgment does not slack, does not go slow. “Even so there is no swiftness of the first”: there’s no swiftness; it does not rush.

So God’s judgments are in a steady rotation: Assyria, Babylon, Persia and Media, Greece, Rome, after that Spain and France, and now we’re here in America with NATO. A steady, steady ring; that’s how God’s judgments are.

So what we read regarding the curses: yes, it applied in the Assyrian captivity; yes, it also applied in the Babylonian captivity; yes, the same thing applied in the Persian and Median captivity; yes, those same curses applied in the Greek and Roman captivity; and yes, those same curses apply in America. It don’t stop and get derailed; it’s the same thing. Only a spiritual man, a spiritual woman, is going to understand that.

sense.text:
Reading Will Durant’s The Story of Civilization, Caesar and Christ: the twelve pooled their material possessions and entrusted Judas with their common funds as they followed Christ (remember it said Judas carried the bag, when Christ was walking the earth), and kindly and pious women joined the apostles and disciples and contributed to their support. So women have always been important in this truth. This ain’t a man thing, this ain’t a sausage fest; the women were always there to support. The things that men needed, the women provided. They were a help meet unto Christ and the disciples, and they have to be a help meet today. Don’t get mad, sisters; that’s what God made you for. That line is for the brothers who said, I’m going to remove my wife from every office in IUIC.

So give me the women that followed Christ: “certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils”.

“And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward”: I wanted that because some of the women were married, and they continued and supported Christ. “And Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.” That’s biblical, sisters, that is biblical; we’re not changing anything.

So brothers, if your wife is in the body, working in the body, she should continue. To stop her from that is very foolish. Half the time that’s what attracted you to that sister, because she was putting in works in the body. So for you to strip her of the joy she has in the Lord, that tells a lot about you.

“Thus saith the Lord God unto the land of Israel”. Unto who? The land of Israel. So Ezekiel 7 is about the land of Israel. “The end is come upon the four corners of the land”: the land, the land, the land. Ezekiel 7 is talking about the end of the land.

“As for the beauty of his ornament”: the beauty of God’s ornament was the temple on the land. “But they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein”: that’s what the ancients of Israel did. The very next chapter tells you how the ancients worshipped idols secretly, and the women of Israel were worshipping Tammuz, Nimrod’s son, which the Christmas idea stemmed from. “Therefore have I set it far from them.”

“And I will give it into the hands of the strangers”. What is the it that he will give into the hand of strangers? The land, the land, the land. “For a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil”: he would give the land to the wicked of the earth for a spoil. “And they shall pollute it”: the wicked, the strangers, shall pollute the land.

“They shall pollute my secret place”: the secret place was when they destroyed the temple and the holy of holies. “For the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it”: now it’s calling those strangers, which were the wicked, robbers.
“Make a chain”: we know that means captivity; we would go into captivity. “For the land is full of bloody crimes”: the land of Israel is full of bloody crimes, “and the city is full of violence.”

precepts.why: Christ said the same thing: “they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”. Trodden down of who? The Gentiles. Christ called them the Gentiles; Ezekiel called them the wicked and strangers. They’re talking about the same thing. “Until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”: until the times of the Gentiles’ rulership be fulfilled.

Pay attention: he’s going to put a name on them. “Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea”: Idumea, that’s Edom, the Ashkenazi; that’s them. “Which have appointed my land into their possession”: Ezekiel tells you the name of the group that appointed God’s land into their possession.

“With the joy of all their heart”: they are happy to take the land; they are happy to murder other people just to keep the land. “With despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey”: they called their fellow Europeans from Poland, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Uzbekistan, Russia, Italy, Yugoslavia and said, come get some of this land. That’s what they do.

Ezekiel calls those strangers robbers, and so does Daniel. “And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south”: that’s talking about Egypt. “Also the robbers of thy people”: y’all see that? The robbers of thy people, that’s Esau, Edom.

“Shall exalt themselves”: they exalt themselves as the people of God, as the Jews. “To establish the vision”: to establish the vision that they are the Jews, that the land is theirs. “But they shall fall.” God says they shall fall; the Bible prophesies they shall fall, so we ain’t making nothing up.

Nahum to explain the chain. “Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity”: the Israelites went into captivity. “Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets”: they destroyed our children, killed our children. “And they cast lots for her honourable men”: they bid for us in slavery. “And all her great men were bound in chains.” In what? That is the time of the barley harvest, the feasts of Passover, unleavened bread and first fruits.

So the month of Abib is between the end of March and the beginning of April. Abib means ear of corn, or literally spring season, and you have this white man in Christianity telling you the year begins in the dead of winter. So what y’all are celebrating this Sunday is beyond me.

Verse 11 seals which month it is talking about: “And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the Lord’s passover.” The month of Abib is when the Passover comes, and that month is the beginning of the months.

“At even is the Lord’s passover. And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the Lord: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.” That is the beginning of the year for us. Christians ain’t figured that out: they got a Bible but will not read it.
